name: mpx
description: Build EncounterPlus V5 modules from Markdown projects.

mpx.autoIncrementVersion.markdownDescription:
Whether to automatically bump `module.json`'s patch version (e.g. `1.0.0` -> `1.0.1`) after each successful build.

Possible values: `true` (default) or `false`.

enumDescriptions: Display generated preview labels in English.
Display generated preview labels in French.
mpx.contentLanguage.markdownDescription:
Language used for labels generated by MPX in Markdown previews and module builds.

Possible values: `"en"` (default), `"fr"`.

enumDescriptions: Use imperial units for English and metric units for French.
Use imperial units unless an entity explicitly requests metric units.
Use metric units unless an entity explicitly requests imperial units.
mpx.defaultMeasurement.markdownDescription:
Default measurement system used for generated labels and prefilled when creating a new Compendium entry. An entry's own `attributes.measurement` value, once set, always takes precedence.

Possible values: `"auto"` (default, imperial for English / metric for French), `"imperial"`, `"metric"`.

Possible values: `true` (default) or `false`.
